subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicitly configured Tailnet-only gateway fail startup when no usable Tailscale IPv4 is available, or intentionally degrade to a host-local loopback listener?
rationale: Failing closed better matches the documented explicit-bind contract, but changing the existing fallback can interrupt upgrades and Tailscale startup-order workflows, so gateway-owner intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Fail explicit Tailnet startup
options.body: Return a clear fatal startup error for an unavailable explicit Tailnet bind while leaving non-explicit auto-binding behavior unchanged.

options.title: Keep the loopback fallback
options.body: Preserve compatibility but update documentation and startup logging to state clearly that explicit Tailnet binding may degrade to loopback.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit Tailnet startup
recommendation.body: Return a clear fatal startup error for an unavailable explicit Tailnet bind while leaving non-explicit auto-binding behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns gateway security posture and upgrade compatibility, and the prior review already routed this boundary to an adjacent gateway owner.
